channel.title: Holistic Life: Gifts for Nurses and Healthcare Workers
channel.description: Gifts for Nurses and Healthcare Workers guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Coworker Gift Ideas for Nurses: Small Gifts That Suit a Whole Unit
item.description: Coworker gift ideas for a nursing unit or any healthcare team: small, unscented and easy to split, so every shift gets something. Start with good pens, hand cream, lip balm, sealed snacks and badge reels, then see seven more ideas and what to leave out. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nursing Graduation Gifts: How to Shop for a New Nurse
item.description: Nursing graduation gifts start with a few simple checks. Ask about their unit, skip engraved and scented items, and add a handwritten note. A nurse-run guide with graduation gift ideas for pinning day. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nurse Thank You Basket for Labor and Delivery: What to Put in It
item.description: A nurse thank you basket for labor and delivery is easy to put together when you know what gets used. Start with sealed snacks, pens, lip balm and hand cream, then add a short note. The guide has the full list, what to look for, and what to leave out. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Christmas Gifts for Coworkers: 12 Small Things a Whole Team Will Use
item.description: Christmas gifts for coworkers work best when they are small, useful and the same for everyone. Here are twelve ideas for an office or a nurses' unit, from good pens and unscented hand cream to sealed snacks and a leakproof mug, with what to look for in each and what to skip. From a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nurse Gift Ideas: What to Buy a Nurse for Christmas
item.description: Nurse gift ideas for Christmas, graduation or Nurses Week. A short checklist of useful gifts for 12-hour shifts, plus the gifts most nurses would rather skip. See what to look for in each one. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nurse Gifts for a New Grad: What a First-Year Nurse Will Use
item.description: Nurse gifts for a new grad's first year on the floor. A short checklist of gear that gets used every shift, plus what to ask first before buying a stethoscope. See what to look for in each. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Nurses That Actually Get Used: 12 Practical Ideas
item.description: Gifts for nurses that get used every shift: compression socks, a leakproof bottle, a fob watch, sleep helpers for night shift and more. Twelve practical ideas from a nurse-run site, with what to look for in each one. Guide contains affiliate links.
